blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — “I vow to fight VAW. We vow to fight VAW.” With those words, House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III urged collective action against violence against women in a video message played Wednesday at the opening of the International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women exhibit. Describing violence against women and children as “often a tragedy hidden behind closed doors,” Dy said the House would consider recommendations from a nationwide review of the Anti-VAWC Law to identify gaps in enforcement and make support easier for survivors to access. “In the House, we will listen to the recommendations […]...
